extracted.name: Tomato Watermelon Salad
extracted.description: This watermelon tomato salad tosses fresh cubes of watermelon with onion, feta, tomatoes, and mint for a delicious and refreshing combo of flavors.
ingredient_lines: 1 large seedless watermelon, cut into 1-inch cubes
1 pinch coarse salt, or to taste
1 pinch ground black pepper, or to taste
instruction_lines: Gently mix watermelon, tomatoes, feta cheese, onion, and mint in a large bowl.
Whisk olive oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper together in a small bowl; drizzle over salad and gently toss to coat.
